title: ドラゴンのリアル調イラスト
lead: 西洋風・東洋風・幼体など、オリジナルのドラゴンを写実的なタッチで描いた素材12点です。ゲーム・小説の挿絵や資料に使えます。
subject_en: Realistic natural-history style rendering of ORIGINAL dragon designs invented for this series, each ONE dragon full body centred, detailed scales and anatomy, natural muted colours, soft shading. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a four-legged green western dragon standing with folded wings
a red western dragon with spread wings, mouth closed
a long serpentine eastern dragon with whiskers coiled through clouds
a two-legged wyvern with bat-like wings perched on a rock
a small dragon hatchling sitting beside a cracked egg
a large speckled dragon egg resting in a nest of straw
a pale blue dragon with frosty scales and spiky crest
a finned sea dragon swimming with a long body
a moss-covered brown dragon with leaf-like frills lying down
a fossilised dragon skull with horns, side view
a close portrait of a dragon head with horns and an amber eye
a dragon's clawed foot gripping a stone
